suggested_experiment_name: BESIII (J/psi -> gamma a, a -> gamma gamma)
notes: BESIII search for ALP a->gamma gamma in J/psi radiative decays, mass range 0.165-2.84 GeV. Sets 95% CL upper limits on g_agamma (AxionPhoton). Only a single numerical point is stated in text: excludes g_agamma > 3e-4 GeV^-1 at m_a ~ 0.25 GeV (2.5e8 eV). Full exclusion curve is only shown in Fig 6 (not numerically available). Collider bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density.
